logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

events.description: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.
The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

events.description: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.
Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

events.description: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.
You have no authority!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

events.description: I have more than enough.
Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

events.description: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.
Get your hands off me! Catherine!
Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.
Do something!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
Alexander... I thought you had died.
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
Do you know what this did to me?

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
I mourned you.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
I waited for you.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
I never stopped loving you.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
You don't remember?

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
I was supposed to be your Duchess!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
You were never my Duchess.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
But I loved you!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
No!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
I loved you before all this!

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
Did you?

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Her?!
Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

beats.scene_heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
